Do you have an example where this is an issue for view engine?
`setLocaleId` is only used for ivy code, and this piece of code is only there temporarily to allow runtime i18n (for ivy) to work with the current view engine code until we have the new i18n service available.
That being said, we could update `_localeFactory` in application_module (that is set after `APP_INITIALIZER`) so that it defines the locale for ivy as well

issue.body:
In `BrowserModule` the value of `LOCALE_ID` is defined in the `APPLICATION_MODULE_PROVIDERS` after `APP_INITIALIZER` has run.
This PR ensures that `LOCALE_ID` is also set for ivy at the same moment which allows the application to fetch the locale from a backend (for example).

Fixes #31465


I also took the opportunity to define the default locale id as a constant for all packages (not just core/render3).

body: Hi @ocombe! That code is intended to being used by Ivy, but it's not. We've only updated Angular version from 7.2.15 to 8.1 and the app our app was broken (we haven't enabled any Ivy flag). We are setting the `LOCALE_ID` with a property `currentLocale` from a `LocaleService`. That property is being set from a backend call using the `APP_INITIALIZER` token, so the application does not even start, because Angular is trying to set the `LOCALE_ID` before we get the current locale for the user from the backend.
Is there an error or something? Without a repro it's hard to figure out what's going wrong.

@ocombe  I think [this](https://stackblitz.com/edit/angular-nkerqf) reproduces it.  the localeId is used before APP_INITIALIZER runs.  The new stackblitz project used version 7.x.x.  as soon as I updated to latest it started throwing this error

As @jasedwards said, the project was using Angular 7.x.x... So i cannot post a repro. The error is that we are trying to set `LOCALE_ID` to the value from the service and then convert it to lower case. So, as the locale has not yet been recovered from the backend, it throws an exception `Cannot read property 'toLowerCase' of undefined`.
oh I see ! Thanks I'll fix that

We ran into the same issue after upgrading to Angular 8 (and without Ivy enabled). We set the LOCALE_ID based on a backend API call (through a `Resolver`), and now the application tries to set the LOCALE_ID before the backend API call is done, so it is set to undefined and causes the `Cannot read property 'toLowerCase' of undefined.` error

(I've posted it here: https://stackoverflow.com/questions/57115654/lazy-loading-and-setting-locale-id-at-runtime-from-an-api-in-angular-8-applicati)

Looking forward to a release that fixes this.
Hi @ocombe , happy to see that you've developed a fix for this. Is there any ETA on when this will land in a new Angular patch release? Thanks! (I see it's not in 8.1.3)
